notes: Skill-adjusted xG (NHL, LightGBM+Optuna, recency-weighted shooter/goalie priors); Table 5 gains largest in high bracket. Port recency-weighted player/defender residual priors to NFL props with shrinkage instead of zero-default.

Causal ATE claim (p=1.43e-52) not credible: treatment defined from composite outcome score, overlapping 30s windows, random splits, proprietary Sportlogiq data. Only sequence-embedding idea salvageable; rebuild from scratch on nflverse.

CS:GO adjusted plus/minus: +-1/0 design matrix, ridge/elastic/Bayesian with Rating2.0 prior; Table II p-values only, no effect sizes. Port to snap-level NFL APM with strict temporal validation; fills map gap (no RAPM-style player decomposition in GSE).

Survey, no equations/experiments. Adopt taxonomy (diversity/balancing/domain-shift/edge-cases x 4 generation eras x 3 filtering objectives) as checklist for constrained rule-based augmentation of rare NFL game states; LLM generation rejected; test window must contain zero synthetic rows.

XGBoost injury model (log loss 0.1676 vs 0.1700 heuristic) + Poisson match model + MCTS squad optimizer; honest null on points (-0.1% +-0.3) with ~13% fewer top-11 injuries. Port to NFL load-management; replace Gaussian durations and shuffled CV with survival modeling and temporal validation.

Training-data contamination of GAX: stars overrepresented in training bias their own residuals (Messi GAX 127.6->120.8 after 4000-shot injection). Mandatory hygiene for GSE props: cross-fitting, multi-calibration by position x volume, atypical-play exclusions, shrinkage.

OpenSkill (Weng-Lin Bayes, Plackett-Luce default): ~3.5x faster than TrueSkill at 2-5pt accuracy cost (Overwatch 87.56% vs 92.44%). Adopt as production rating engine only if within 0.002 log-loss of house Elo on 2020-2024 walk-forward; do not use unweighted team updates for individual props.

CAMP: wicket penalty w=1 and bat/bowl weights (1, 0.2) tuned to maximize MoM agreement on the same 961-match corpus; no held-out validation; all-22 rank-1 shows no edge over LNC (47.6% vs 47.9%). Decomposition concept salvageable only as held-out snap-APM rebuild per ledger 0421.

NMSTPP: transformer-encoded 40-event history, joint t/z/m forecast (val total loss 4.40 vs 4.57/4.51/4.48 baselines), HPUS possession metric correlates -0.78 with final ranking. Port to NFL drive sequences; fills map gap 14 (Hawkes/self-exciting models). Code public.

Aggregated ceteris-paribus profiles (semi-global XAI) for per-player/per-team what-ifs on expected-metric models; 315k shots, 7 seasons. Adopt AP layer only (not the ROSE-over-sampled RF: paper's own Fig.5 shows resampling shifts behavior; original-data model has better Brier 0.051 vs 0.071).
